title: Add The Basement Circuit to games
author: pollinations-ai[bot]

gist.summary: Added @fisventurous’s The Basement Circuit to the games catalog and README’s recent-apps list. The web autobattler uses Pollinations to turn a description of up to 80 characters into a fighter’s fight card, including personality traits. MIDI Journey 2 rotated out of the README’s recent-apps list; this change does not remove it from the catalog.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art basement game room, Polli wears a tiny referee cap and studies a glowing fight card beside a retro terminal, with little code-plants growing around the ring. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized and shares the frame with the scene, never oversized or dominating it, in strictly pixel art style, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874) glow and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
